advisor_identified: Gershon David Hundert, professor of History and Jewish Studies at McGill University.

doctorate.title: Security and Dependence: Perspectives on Seventeenth-Century Polish-Jewish Society Gained through a Study of Jewish Merchants in Little Poland

evidence.says: McGill lists Gershon Hundert as Leanor Segal Professor of Jewish Studies, jointly appointed with History and Classical Studies, with a Ph.D. from Columbia.

Hundert’s article identifies his affiliation as McGill’s Department of History. Reference 10 cites his Security and Dependence dissertation, using a shortened title, as a Columbia University Ph.D. dissertation of 1978.

Sudoc catalogue record 006488285, verified through its public RDF, identifies a thesis by Gershon David Hundert with the full matching subtitle and a 1978 University Microfilms edition. The catalogue spells the first title phrase Security and dependance.

Search-indexed front matter identifies Dana Herman’s Hashavat Avedah as a McGill History Ph.D. thesis dated October 2008; its indexed acknowledgments name Gershon David Hundert as her thesis supervisor.

notes: The linked record matches the advisor’s Columbia doctorate in institution, year and dissertation title. Minor differences are seventeenth-century versus 17th-century and the Sudoc spelling dependance. The student-thesis front matter and McGill degree listing were available through search indexing; direct retrieval was restricted.
